mapper.sql: id, advisor_code, advisor_name, advisor_type, enabled, config_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select
from advisor where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} limit 1

select
from advisor where 1 = 1 and advisor_code = #{advisorCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into advisor ( advisor_code, advisor_name, advisor_type, enabled, config_json, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{advisorCode}, #{advisorName}, #{advisorType}, #{enabled}, #{configJson}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update advisor set advisor_code = #{advisorCode}, advisor_name = #{advisorName}, advisor_type = #{advisorType}, enabled = #{enabled}, config_json = #{configJson}, updated_at = now() where 1 = 1 and id = #{id}
update advisor set enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() where 1 = 1 and id = #{id}
